empty.title: Your runs will show up here
empty.text: Distance, pace and the coach's analysis for every run. Import a file from your watch or log one by hand.

errors.importFailed: Something went wrong during the import.
errors.gpxOnly: Only .gpx files exported from Strava are supported.

new.title: New run
new.intro: Pace and zones are calculated automatically.

review.title: Review activity
review.intro: Data extracted successfully. You can edit it before saving.
review.notesPlaceholder: E.g. heavy legs, hot, easy breathing…

file.label: GPX or FIT file
file.choose: Tap to choose a .gpx and/or .fit file
file.helpSources: .gpx or .fit files exported from Strava, Garmin, Coros or Zepp. You can also select both (GPX + FIT) for the same activity: the data gets combined.
file.helpAuto: The sport is detected from the file. Pace, HR zones, splits, cadence and cardiac drift are calculated automatically.
file.unsupported: Unsupported format: use a .gpx or .fit file.
file.tooMany: Two files at most: one .gpx and one .fit from the same activity.
file.needPair: With two files, you need a .gpx and a .fit from the same activity.

edit.intro: Edit your workout details. Pace and zones will be recalculated.
edit.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this run? This can't be undone.
edit.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the run. Try again.

evaluation.title: The coach's comment

evaluation.quotaHint: Wait for your free limit to reset before trying again.
evaluation.notesPlaceholder: Heavy legs, hot weather… and if you did intervals, what they looked like: 3 × (3' hard + 1' jog + 1' sprint)
